entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed operand is not admitted for %s at %s
entries.rationale: This is a fail-closed registration invariant, not a query rejection. lowerSortFloatOperand calls prepareSortOperand only for the sort operand and existing-plan sites, both registered mixedFloatOnly in mixedOperandPolicies. The direct site checks policy before checked shadow resolution; the existing-plan site is consulted only after original lowering succeeds and yields Mixed. Ordinary samples bypass it and histogram/drop early identities are unchanged. Queries cannot mutate the policy table or choose an unsupported site or mode; only internal misuse and authority tests reach this error.
